key_insight: MANTA lets a multi-agent system adapt its communication topology at inference time, so collaboration structure can self-evolve when the current organization is no longer effective.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to improve robustness and task performance in deployed multi-agent workflows without changing the task interface or increasing the agent budget.
method: Initialize a task-conditioned topology from prior structural experience before execution.
Monitor collaboration traces during deployment and trigger bounded structural updates when needed.
Adapt roles, links, execution order, visibility, and validation pathways while preserving the agent budget.
evidence_signal: Across five benchmarks spanning information seeking, tool use, planning, workflow execution, and mathematical reasoning, MANTA achieved the highest average score of 74.0 and beat the strongest baseline by 5.8 points, with the best result on PlanCraft.
watch_item: Runtime topology adaptation may add implementation complexity and requires careful safeguards to avoid unstable or over-aggressive structural changes.
paper_title: MANTA: Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation for Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
